entities.summary: Dame Ivy Leona Dumont, is a Bahamian politician who served as the seventh governor-general of the Bahamas. She was the first woman in the Bahamas to hold this office, from 1 January 2002 until 30 November 2005. She previously served as Minister of Education from 1995 to 2001.
